mangal_dosha.name: Mangal Dosha
mangal_dosha.description: Mars placed in houses 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, or 12 from Lagna, Moon, or Venus, causing marital difficulties and discord in relationships.

mild.description: Mars in 1st or 2nd house - lesser impact

moderate.description: Mars in 4th or 12th house - moderate impact

severe.description: Mars in 7th or 8th house - severe impact on marriage

effects: Delay in marriage and conjugal happiness
Death of spouse or early widowhood (in severe cases)
Aggressive and quarrelsome temperament in relationships
remedies: Marry after 28 years of age (for males) or 25 years (for females)
Perform Kumbh Vivah (marriage to a pot or tree before actual marriage)
Wear red coral (Moonga) gemstone after astrological consultation
Visit Mangal Nath temple or Mars temples on Tuesdays
Donate red items (red clothes, red lentils) on Tuesdays
Practice meditation and anger management techniques

cancellation.description: Mars in its own signs Aries or Scorpio cancels the dosha completely
Mars in its exalted sign Capricorn cancels the dosha
Jupiter's aspect on Mars cancels the dosha
Mars conjunct Jupiter cancels the dosha
If both marriage partners have Mangal Dosha, it is mutually neutralized
Mars in 1st, 4th, 7th, or 8th house of fire signs (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) or air signs (Aquarius) or earth sign (Capricorn)
Mars in 2nd house of Gemini or Virgo (air/earth signs)
Mars in 12th house of Taurus or Libra (earth/air signs)

kaal_sarp_dosha.name: Kaal Sarp Dosha
kaal_sarp_dosha.description: All seven planets (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn) are hemmed between Rahu and Ketu nodes along the zodiac axis, creating a serpentine entrapment.

partial_kaal_sarp.description: When one planet is outside the Rahu-Ketu axis, called Partial Kaal Sarp Dosha

effects: Delays and obstacles in all endeavors
Lack of peace and mental stability
remedies: Chant Rahu and Ketu mantras regularly
Offer milk and mustard oil to Rahu and Ketu
Wear hessonite (Gomed) for Rahu and cat's eye (Lehsunia) for Ketu
Visit Kaal Sarp temples, especially the Kalahasti temple in Andhra Pradesh
Perform Nag Puja (serpent worship) on Nag Panchami
Chant Hanuman Chalisa for spiritual protection
Perform Lakshmi Puja to attract positive energies

cancellation.description: Strong Jupiter placement can reduce the severity of Kaal Sarp Dosha
Sun aspected by benefics can provide relief
Strong 9th house lord provides spiritual protection

pitra_dosha.name: Pitra Dosha
pitra_dosha.description: Ancestral karma dosha caused by affliction of Sun, 9th house, or 9th house lord by malefics, particularly Rahu, indicating unresolved ancestral debts or karmic imbalances.

types.mild: Sun or 9th house afflicted by Rahu only
types.moderate: Sun conjunct Rahu or 9th lord afflicted
types.severe: Multiple afflictions with complete blockage of 9th house

effects: Lack of success despite hard work
remedies: Offer water and food to crows and birds
Respect and serve parents and elders
Perform Pitra Yagna or ancestral rituals
Chant Rahu and Ketu mantras for appeasement
Visit sacred temples and perform charity
Fast on Sundays and offer to Sun God
Donate grains and food on Sundays

cancellation.description: Sun in Leo (own sign) mitigates the dosha
Sun in Aries (exalted sign) cancels the dosha
Jupiter's aspect on Sun provides relief
Strong 9th house lord without affliction cancels the dosha
Regular performance of Shraddha and ancestor worship reduces effects

grahan_dosha.name: Grahan Dosha
grahan_dosha.description: Eclipse affliction dosha caused by Sun or Moon conjunct with shadow planets Rahu or Ketu, causing eclipse-like affliction of luminaries.
effects: Loss of vital energy and confidence
Health issues related to lungs and heart
remedies: Perform eclipse remedies during solar and lunar eclipses
Chant Sun mantras (Om Suryaya Namaha) for Sun affliction
Chant Moon mantras (Om Chandaya Namaha) for Moon affliction
Chant Rahu and Ketu mantras for appeasement
Wear gemstones: Ruby for Sun, Pearl for Moon
Wear hessonite (Gomed) for Rahu and cat's eye (Lehsunia) for Ketu
Offer milk and honey to Moon, and milk and mustard oil to Rahu

cancellation.description: Sun in Leo reduces the impact
Moon in Cancer reduces the impact
Conjunction in a sign where both planets are friendly
Aspect of benefic planets (Jupiter, Venus) on the conjunction

guru_chandal_dosha.name: Guru Chandal Dosha
guru_chandal_dosha.description: Malefic combination where Jupiter (Guru) is conjunct with or aspected by Rahu (Chandal), causing confusion in wisdom and judgment.
effects: Loss of wisdom and poor judgment
Relationship with gurus or mentors becomes problematic
Addiction to intoxicants or unhealthy habits
remedies: Chant Rahu mantras and seek appeasement
Seek guidance from a spiritual mentor
Donate yellow items and food on Thursdays
Visit temples and offer flowers to deity

cancellation.description: Jupiter in Sagittarius or Pisces mitigates the dosha
Jupiter in Cancer (exalted sign) cancels the dosha
Jupiter aspecting Rahu from a distance can reduce impact
Aspect of Sun or Mercury on Jupiter provides relief

shani_dosha.name: Shani Dosha
shani_dosha.description: Saturn affliction or difficult Saturn placement causing obstruction, limitation, and hardship. Includes Sade Sati (7.5-year Saturn transit over Moon) and other Saturn-related afflictions.

conditions.description: Saturn transit in Moon's sign or adjacent signs for 7.5 years
Saturn in 4th or 8th house from Moon (2.5 years each)

phases.description: Saturn in 12th from Moon - loss and expenditure
Saturn in Moon's sign - peak difficulty and obstruction
Saturn in 2nd from Moon - pressure and challenges

dhaiya.name: Dhaiya (Small Panoti)
dhaiya.description: Saturn in 4th or 8th house from Moon

effects: Obstruction and delays in all endeavors
remedies: Chant Saturn mantras (Om Shanicharaya Namaha) daily
Fast on Saturdays (preferably complete or partial)
Offer oil and sesame to Saturn
Donate black items, iron, or oil on Saturdays
Recite Shani Stotra or Shani Chalisa

cancellation.description: Saturn in Capricorn or Aquarius reduces severity
Saturn in Libra (exalted sign) mitigates the dosha
Jupiter's aspect on Saturn provides relief
Strong 9th house provides spiritual protection
Saturn as Yogakaraka planet may reduce negative effects

kemdrum_dosha.name: Kemdrum Dosha
kemdrum_dosha.description: Moon without planetary support in 2nd and 12th houses, causing isolation, lack of confidence, and mental instability without proper guidance.

conditions.description: Moon without any planet in adjacent houses

effects: Lack of mental peace and tranquility
remedies: Offer milk and rice to Moon
Seek support from family and friends
Develop inner confidence through spiritual practice
Keep company with positive and supportive people
Engage in artistic and creative pursuits

cancellation.description: Moon in Cancer mitigates the dosha
Moon in Taurus (exalted sign) cancels the dosha
Aspect of Jupiter or Venus on Moon provides support
Strong planet in Lagna provides support to Moon
Mercury in 2nd or 12th house provides mental support

rule_evaluation.single_condition: Dosha is present if condition is met
rule_evaluation.multiple_conditions: All must be true if all_conditions_required is true, otherwise any condition is sufficient
rule_evaluation.cancellation: Apply after main condition detection to mitigate or cancel the dosha

severity_scale.severe: Major life disruptions, professional guidance strongly recommended
